next_question: On a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application whose goal texts are authored by a process that never sees the mechanism intent strings, with a preregistered contamination screen that measures every goal's overlap against EVERY intent in the registry (not only against its own family target) and a preregistered authoring-provenance record showing intents and goals were produced in separate stages by separate artifacts: does max-cosine-similarity selection over intent embeddings still bind the correct mechanism on goals never seen at authoring time, and by how much does it exceed a token-overlap null on those same independently authored goals - that is, does the 45/52 against 33/52 advantage measured here (paired family-blocked difference 0.2308, 95% CI [0.1136, 0.3509], all-MiniLM-L6-v2, one fixture, one run) survive removal of the joint-authorship confound, or was it an artifact of intents and goal templates being authored in the same execute-time file by the same agent that reported the numbers? Six instrument properties are preregistration preconditions, each of which failed as a code literal, a tautology or an unattainable target in the packet just closed. (i) The reference arm must be provably DISTINCT from the candidate: B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX was provably identical to A-CANDIDATE because argmax_i sigma(w*cos_i+b) = argmax_i cos_i, and the two arms selected the same mechanism on all 52 applicable goals, so the primary gate compared the embedding signal with lexical overlap and tested no gate at all. (ii) The positive control must be capable of FAILING: PC-VERBATIM-INTENT is byte-identical to the intent string, so every monotone-similarity arm including the lexical null scores 12/12 and V2 carries no information. (iii) Every numeric target must be attainable under the frozen parameterisation, and a target that no setting can reach must be deleted before freeze rather than scored after it: ece_global <= 0.15 is unattainable because the single feature is capped at sigmoid(w+b) = 0.7977 against a class that is 100 percent applicable, and unknown_precision >= 0.85 is satisfied at 1.0 by exactly the inertness the dynamic-range precondition exists to catch, the two gates being jointly satisfiable only by admitting at most one false abstention (14/15) on a 9-goal validation split whose floor resolution is 1/9 = 0.1111 against a 0.10 requirement. (iv) The null control must be satisfiable: NC-NO-APPLICABLE required abstention = 1.0 while forbidding DEFER-to-abstention merging, which no slot-filling resolver can attain, so it fired for every arm. (v) The primary denominator must be declared once and identically in metric code and preregistration, and the realized split must be compared against the declared split before fitting: this packet's headline 0.9286 counted 6 DEFER rows as correct (recomputed 45/52, 35/42, 19/23) while prereg.md 6.3 excludes the deferral stratum, and the realized 29/9/14 applicable and 16/5/7 no-applicable contradicted the frozen 32/10/10 and 17/5/6, so the primary gate ran on 14 test goals instead of the 10 that were frozen. (vi) Code binding must use only what the deterministic control plane can satisfy: a sha256 of a module that already exists at freeze time declared inside prereg.md, which freeze.json does hash, recomputed by EXECUTE and failed on mismatch - the four digests of the now-committed research/harness modules are available for exactly that purpose - and no validity condition of the form 'code hashed into freeze.json', which scripts/freeze_experiment.py can never satisfy and which has now invalidated three consecutive Graph packets, the last of them while being falsely attested PASS. The reusable instrument contract itself - which validity gates are code literals, which targets are unattainable, which controls cannot fail, and which preregistration clauses pre-state outcomes - belongs to C-MEAS-VALID (owner lanes runtime and physics) and should be handed there rather than re-derived inside a fourth graph packet. This question deliberately changes the object of study from tuning a threshold to removing the authorship confound, because three consecutive packets in the C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE thread have been lost to design- and control-plane defects and none has validly tested calibration; a bounded negative here would not close C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, and a positive here would be the first contamination-free evidence in the thread.
why_next: This packet is a valid MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome whose scientific yield was extracted by the independent audit, and the next question moves to a materially different object of study rather than repairing this one in place. Three reasons. First, the causal question this packet was built to answer was never validly asked: prereg.md 7.1 short-circuits at gates 1-7, two of which fired (V13 instrument dynamic range, and NC-NO-APPLICABLE, with derived_evidence/gate_table.json recording both as false), so the primary and secondary gate verdicts are not verdicts about the claim. Second, the audit established that the packet's own instrument could not have adjudicated the question in either direction, and it did so with specific, checkable instances rather than general complaint: the substitute reference arm is provably the same selector as the candidate because the argmax of a strictly increasing transform of cosine is the argmax of cosine, so the primary gate tested no gate; the positive control and the oracle cannot fail by construction; the ECE threshold is unattainable under the frozen single-feature parameterisation and is numerically invariant at 0.2583 across the entire exercised threshold range with zero applicable-class abstentions, so it cannot distinguish a working gate from an inert one; UNKNOWN precision of 1.0 is earned by exactly the inertness the dynamic-range precondition exists to catch; the null control is structurally unsatisfiable; the dynamic-range precondition has a floor resolution of 1/9 = 0.1111 against a 0.10 requirement and is evaluated on the same 9-goal split used to choose the threshold; and 8 of the 13 validity conditions are code literals assigned True in the runner. Third, and decisively for direction, the one reproducible positive result - max-cosine selection binding 45/52 applicable goals against 33/52 for a token-overlap null, paired family-blocked difference 0.2308 with 95% CI [0.1136, 0.3509] - is uninterpretable as evidence, because the mechanism intents and the goal templates were authored in the same execute-time file (research/harness/goal_generator.py INTENTS) by the same agent that produced and reported the numbers, the 12 verbatim goals are byte-identical to their target intents, and none of the outcome-bearing code, the fixture or the goal set existed at the freeze commit. The next question therefore asks whether that advantage survives when goals are authored by a process that never sees the intents, measured by a contamination screen against every intent rather than against the goal's own family target. That is a different level of description (authoring independence) rather than another tuning pass, it is executable now with stdlib HTTP and no credentials, and it is the only move that can convert this thread's positive signal into evidence or kill it. The reusable instrument findings are routed to C-MEAS-VALID, whose owner lanes are runtime and physics, rather than being re-derived inside a fourth graph packet, and the code-binding remedy is escalated as a control-plane decision. continue=false because the repairs are design- and control-plane-level and a NEW experiment requires a Global Research Director mandate (AGENTS.md global direction discipline; research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 2), which the graph lane cannot self-authorize, and because a fourth pass in this shape is expected by the audit to reproduce the same control-plane invalidity rather than discriminate anything.

THE DECISIVE DEFECT IS THE THRESHOLD RULE, NOT THE FEATURE AND NOT THE ARCHITECTURE. The preregistered positive-class-F1 rule (candidate_resolver.py:106-133) selected t = 0.47 on a 9-goal validation split, which is 0.0339 below the lowest applicable score on all 52 goals (0.5039); a threshold of 0.504 would have fired on at least one applicable goal and cleared V13's application side. A jointly satisfying operating point for the frozen pair coverage >= 0.50 and pooled false-accept <= 0.10 DOES exist on the same fitted feature, but only for t >= 0.65 under the metric the gates actually use: at t = 0.65 coverage 0.7885 and false-accept 0.0952, at t ~ 0.75 coverage 0.5385 and false-accept 0.0000, breaking above t ~ 0.79; it costs 21 to 46 percent of the applicable stratum. The gate-only proxy reads 0.0612 at t ~ 0.58, but the frozen metric at that same threshold is 0.1633 and fails, so the satisfying region is materially narrower than the gate-only frontier suggests. This is an audit finding about the design, not a route to a PASS for this run, which is spent.
